method: Unlinked sockets use exact original Principled values. Linked fields use Cycles emission evaluation at 1024 deterministic area-weighted samples on the largest actual exported source object carrying that material. The donor retains its source object matrix, preserving object and world coordinate fields. All sampled colors are linear.
limitations: Surface-sampled means restore a plausible source-backed uniform PBR response; procedural texture variation and bump are not restored by this table.
Single-source-object representative means are not whole-scene averages. Sampled object, standard deviation, range, and standard error are recorded.
The three full-texture restorations are excluded so this table cannot overwrite them.

summary.baseColorMetalnessAnisotropy: All checked single-Principled materials retain the source constants in the GLB; no overrides are needed for these channels.
summary.roughnessCause: All 21 recommended roughness overrides replace missing linked source networks whose exported effective fallback is 1. No source material has an intentional constant roughness of 1.
summary.swatches: Objects starting with sw are excluded from surface measurement. M_SednaPerlage occurs only on a hidden swatch and receives no override.
